Skipped when no sentinels are named.'; no threaded comments present: persons/person.xml empty, drawings empty)
task/environment/assets/seed_data.json (parsed in full; byte-identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json, sha256 a1c65c80...3740)
evidence: Inventory of every value the judge prompts tell the judge to CREATE, checked against the parsed seed (3 jobs, 16 applications, 127 messages, 3 notes, 6 reads, no activity rows) and the reference initial markup (index.html contains only the sign-in form and empty containers; all other UI is runtime-rendered). (1) Board records: functional prompt.md:15 'Use your own new jobs and cards for every board protocol (suffix every title and name for this review)'; gates (constraints judge.toml hro_gate_shared, functional/polish/visual gate text) require 'a unique name, a unique email address' and 'find exactly one card for that candidate'; polish prompt 'suffix titles for this review'. Suffixed J1/J2/J3 and A-F, V-Z, A2 cannot collide with the 16 seeded names or emails. (2) Fixed literals: 'plain' (hro_msg_compose, protocol T) - no seed message contains '' or 'plain' (grep of seed, index.html and JS: only 'text/plain' dataTransfer in board.js:242/303, unrelated; 'plain text' appears only in brief notes hireops_rules.md:144, not in the app); it is sent into a brand-new J2 conversation, and the judge must observe its own message rendered literally, so nothing pre-satisfies it. 'Call back on Fri' (hro_pol_live_board) - absent from seed notes and markup; polish prompt also says 'If a message or note box already holds text from an earlier review, record it and clear it before typing your own', which neutralises carry-over from earlier dimensions. (3) Judge-chosen distinctive values: K rejection reason 'ending in a unique suffix (search every candidate response for it)'; polish 'distinctive reply' in failed_send and session_resume; role replays need 'a new unique name and email', 'a new unique title', 'a note with new text'; timed actions 'Give every message, note or card created inside a timed action a unique suffix for this review so the watched text cannot match anything older' (functional and polish Timed observations). (4) Negative/notice probes in reference initial state: the scrolled-up notice is threads.js:88-89 'fresh.hidden = !c.pending' so no '1 new message' text is visible before a real arrival; Seen/Sent receipts are per own-message (threads.js:82); seed has no activity table rows, so hro_activity lines can only come from the review's own suffixed actions. (5) Values intentionally present in the seed are read-expectations, not mutation probes: 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' (seed notes[0], read in Z/D), Platform Engineer order Greta(1)/Ade(2)/Marco(3) Applied and Priya(1)/Samuel(2) Screen (matches seed positions), Lena 1 unread (APP-301 has 3 messages, her read_count 2), Noor 120 messages numbered (#001)-(#120). tomas.varga@candidates.example is the seeded candidate account email by design (app_context: 'Adding a candidate with one of the candidate account emails gives that account the application'); Tomas's seeded application is on the Data Analyst job (APP-201), whereas hro_candidate_linked requires the new card on the review's own suffixed J2 (or J3), so his pre-existing application cannot satisfy the link probe. Plausible broken app tried: one that shows Tomas only his seeded Data Analyst application - fails hro_candidate_linked because the J2 title is new and suffixed. Conforming alternative tried: an app whose markup ships placeholder text or a hidden notice - the criteria read typed values/document.activeElement and visible arrival within a timed window, so a conforming app is not failed by a pre-existing string. Colderwater lessons checked for this row: no public internet probe values (lesson 13), restart probe uses multiple distinctive per-review records plus seeded order/note re-read after a real restart_app (lesson 15). Deterministic checker check-probe-not-in-seed.py was applied by hand only (not executed); a naive literal grep would hit tomas.varga@candidates.example and the seeded note, which are expected-present read values, not created probes. Static source review only; no runtime evidence is required to decide this row.
notes: Minor, non-blocking observation outside this row's core: hro_stale_refused accepts the changer's name 'in the response or on screen'; Mei Lin's name may already be visible elsewhere (e.g. Activity). The criterion still requires the refusal itself to identify the person, so this is not a pre-satisfied created probe; owners may consider tying 'on screen' to the refusal message for clarity (rows 32/33 territory).
